actions: Reviewed and squash-merged PR #39 (desktop layout above 1024px) against all nine acceptance criteria of Issue #38, using the browser-evidence CI artifact screenshots at 360/768/1280px in both languages

Posted a review comment on PR #39 recording per-criterion evidence, the one accepted gap (no 1280px no-scroll assertion, covered in effect by the tighter 1024px case), and that Codex's external review raised no findings

Created Issue #40 'feat(notes): a per-day notes area so context can be recorded on the day' with context, build instructions, 11 testable acceptance criteria, DECISIONS.md requirements and out-of-scope, labelled ready
Verified the deployed GitHub Pages site returns HTTP 200
Did not create a DONE Issue: the GOAL.md Daily Planning requirement 'add useful context or notes to the day' has no implementation
agent_report.summary:
Merged PR #39, the desktop layout pass for Issue #38. All nine acceptance criteria hold against the diff and the browser-evidence screenshots: container widths pinned at 360/768/1280, the pt-BR heading and a three-word priority now render on one line, every add-form keeps its button on the input's row including Commitments and Deadlines, the language switcher shares the header band with the day nav, and all 95 pre-existing tests are unmodified. One gap accepted rather than bounced: acceptance criterion 6 names 1280px for the no-horizontal-scroll check and the new test covers only 768px and 1024px — above the breakpoint .page is capped at 1080px and centred, so 1024px is the strictly tighter case and it passes. Codex reviewed commit 1c25f55 with no findings. Reasoning recorded in a PR comment.

With work in flight back to zero, created Issue #40 (ready): a per-day notes area. GOAL.md's Daily Planning section requires "add useful context or notes to the day" and nothing implements it — no notes field in index.html, no notes key in state.js, no string in either i18n catalogue. This is the last absent capability in the product; everything else outstanding is refinement of something that already exists. The Issue pins storage on the day record with getDay-style normalisation of pre-existing payloads, placement after Commitments in DOM order, strings in both catalogues, and requires that a note must not make a day count as having planned work, appear in the Unfinished panel, or move week progress.

The project is not DONE and no DONE Issue was created: a required capability is absent. For the next run — the 641-1023px band is still frozen by #38, and pt-br-tablet-768.png in the artifact shows it retains all three defects PR #39 fixed at desktop widths. That is the strongest candidate once #40 lands.
